description: List application person + Job attachments visible to the current principal. Filter by --job-id to find candidates for a role, and by --hiring-manager-decision (advanced, held or waiting) for where the hiring manager's decision stands. Only the job's recruiter or hiring manager, organization admins and whoever may decide the step can see the decision; for anyone else that filter matches nothing.
name: yardstick_applications_list
title: List applications
